items.title: On Holding stock jumps premarket after signing Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappé
items.summary: Investing.com -- On Holding AG (NYSE:ONON) has signed French superstar Kylian Mbappé as a global ambassador and product development partner, marking the Swiss sportswear company’s official entry into the global football market. The move represents a direct challenge to the longstanding dominance of Nike Inc (NYSE:NKE) and Adidas AG (OTC:ADDYY), sending On Holding’s shares up 5.6% in premarket trading on Friday while Nike and Adidas dipped 0.8% and 1%, respectively.
